findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_onboarding_catalog, quote_onboarding_products, create_onboarding, get_onboarding_payment_link · Private data: quote_onboarding_products, verify_onboarding_email · Public sink: list_onboarding_catalog, create_onboarding, verify_onboarding_email, set_company_context.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_onboarding_catalog, quote_onboarding_products, create_onboarding, get_onboarding_payment_link · Private data: quote_onboarding_products, verify_onboarding_email · Public sink: list_onboarding_catalog, create_onboarding, verify_onboarding_email, set_company_context

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
